title: AlphaFold-Multimer screen predicted Tmem81 as a fertilization factor, confirmed in zebrafish and mice
summary: An AlphaFold-Multimer screen predicted a trimeric sperm complex; the lab then showed Tmem81 is essential for male fertility in zebrafish and mice.
account: In a paper published in Cell on 17 October 2024, the Pauli laboratory and collaborators reported that an AlphaFold-Multimer screen identified Tmem81 as part of a conserved trimeric sperm complex with the known essential fertilization factors Izumo1 and Spaca6. The prediction was then tested at the bench: the authors demonstrated that Tmem81 is essential for male fertility in zebrafish and mice, showed that Izumo1, Spaca6 and Tmem81 interact in zebrafish sperm and that the human orthologues interact in vitro, and found that complex formation creates the binding site for the egg factor Bouncer in zebrafish. The screen and the validation were performed independently of AlphaFold's developer.
purpose: Predict protein-protein complexes in order to find missing components of the vertebrate sperm-egg interaction machinery.
deployer: Research Institute of Molecular Pathology (Pauli lab) and collaborators

ratings.reason: The AI screen handed the laboratory a specific, testable candidate (Tmem81) that it then validated genetically and biochemically, a material result for that research group.
Identification of a conserved vertebrate fertilization factor essential for male fertility in two species advances a long-standing open question; the source demonstrates no clinical application yet.

ai_role.statement: AlphaFold-Multimer generated the hypothesis that Tmem81 belongs to a trimeric complex with Izumo1 and Spaca6. The functional claim rests on wet-lab work by the same laboratory: knockouts in zebrafish and mice, interaction assays in zebrafish sperm, and in vitro interaction of the human orthologues.

evidence.citation: Deneke VE, Blaha A, Lu Y, et al. (2024). A conserved fertilization complex bridges sperm and egg in vertebrates. Cell.
evidence.title: A conserved fertilization complex bridges sperm and egg in vertebrates
evidence.quote: Using an AlphaFold-Multimer screen, we identified the protein Tmem81 as part of a conserved trimeric sperm complex with the essential fertilization factors Izumo1 and Spaca6.
